svg.title: Arthur Fazioni: Full-Stack Software Engineer
svg.desc: Terminal window running whoami: Arthur Fazioni, Full-Stack Software Engineer, B.Sc. Computer Science at UNISAGRADO, Full-Stack Developer at Next SI. Builds B2B products end to end with React, TypeScript, Node.js, PHP, SQL, Docker and Linux. Open to Software Engineer roles in Ireland and remote.

text.tspan: "I build B2B products end to end: React and
TypeScript on the front, Node.js, PHP and SQL
on the back, Docker and Linux underneath, from
the first sketch all the way to production.
I started in IT infrastructure, which taught me
that code has to hold up in production: tested,
simple to deploy and easy to maintain. Open to
Software Engineer roles in Ireland and remote."
typescript · react · node.js · python · php · sql · docker · linux
